about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Our team of guides and the agency's story.
about.banner_title: We discover the world with care
about.banner_description: Baidarken was born out of love for mountains, small groups, and stories that stay with us for a long time.
about.story_p1: In 2016, a small group of friends set out for Sary-Chelek. We wanted to share places we loved with people close to us — and that became our first route.
about.story_p2: Today, 42 guides work with us. They know the mountain trails, look after every guest, and help travelers experience the real Kyrgyzstan.
about.story_image_alt: A wooden cabin by a mountain lake, where the first trips began
about.values_description: They guide our choices of routes, partners, and everyday decisions.

samples.text: We saw incredible places, but most of all we felt like part of the team. Our guide Beket knew when to share a story and when to let us enjoy the mountains in silence.
Our guide brought a group of strangers together so well that a week later we said goodbye as friends. Everything was well organized, with room to enjoy the journey at our own pace.
Our first big trip with the children, and the parents got to relax too. The route was wonderful, the food was great, and the kids still remember every stop.
